description: This source file contains unit tests for the EventHub statistics monitoring features within the Orleans-based streaming system. It defines a test class 'EHStatisticMonitorTests' which includes setup of a test fixture, configuration of streaming components, and test methods for monitoring counters related to EventHub receiver, cache, and object pool. The tests ensure that the monitoring system correctly tracks various internal counters during stream processing.
